media.caption: A lazer kitten turns one research record into polished outputs with a safe optical workflow.

title: Lazer Kitten Research Lab
subtitle: A tiny experiment in reusable research storytelling

sections.mission: Make research activity data easy to validate, delightful to explore, and ready to reuse across many communication formats.
sections.challenge: Research teams often maintain separate descriptions, citations, graphics, and fact sheets. Those copies drift apart and make even a tiny update surprisingly difficult to publish consistently.
approach: Maintain one structured project record beside its supporting visual asset.
Check and format the record before generating downstream artifacts.
Produce citation metadata and a polished PDF from one source.
impact: Project metadata stays consistent across human-readable and machine-readable outputs.
Repeatable commands shorten the path from an edit to a shareable artifact.
A playful example makes the complete workflow safe to learn and easy to remember.

research.focus: Reusable research metadata and automated content production
